'NO TO DEVELOPMENT AGGRESSION': Cordillera groups hold simultaneous petition submission and protest action in front of the National Commission on Indigenous People office in Quezon City, November 26.

Coinciding with the 71st Annual National Mine Safety and Environment Conference Parade, dubbed as ‘Mine Safety Week’ at Baguio City, the delegation register their urgent demands against the plunder of ancestral lands this week in the metro.

“Over recent years, rapid policy shifts have facilitated the fast-tracking of foreign investment in mining and energy. […] NCIP has advanced amendments to the 2012 FPIC Guidelines without genuine consultation with Indigenous Peoples,” Cordillera Peoples Alliance said in a statement. (via Jhona Reyes Vitor, Gen Feliciano/Altermidya)
